KaTeX 0.18.7 (MIT license; see LICENSE).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz
Documentation: https://katex.org/docs/autorender.html

Vendored browser bundle, auto-render extension, stylesheet, and WOFF2 fonts.
Keep these files at the same version when upgrading. The service worker caches
the bundles and fonts so mathematical content also renders offline.
